description: CDE Estaciones depuradoras de aguas residuales (EDAR) y plantas desalinizadoras de agua de mar (IDAM) is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by ideib.caib.es. -Wastewater treatment plants (EDAR): To publicize the location of water infrastructures managed by a public entity and intended for the treatment of wastewater. This treatment consists of a series of physical, chemical and biological processes that aim to eliminate the physical, chemical and biological contaminants present in the effluent water. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "DATASET Wastewater treatment plants (EDAR) and seawater desalination plants (IDAM)" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Eivissa, Depuradoras, Depuradores, ICGIB, Mallorca, Illes Balears. The listing shows 1 download or service links in WMS. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
